phrase.zh: 相似与差异，讲述共同的来路。
phrase.en: Resemblance and difference tell a shared history.

visual.zh: 人物与枝状生命图景相接，动物和植物沿画面展开，借“树”表达亲缘关系。枝条不是由真实物种数据绘制的系统发育树。
visual.en: A stylized figure meets a branching scene of plants and animals, using a tree to suggest relationships. These branches are not a phylogenetic tree built from species data.

background.zh: 达尔文于 1859 年出版《物种起源》，提出自然选择解释物种如何在世代间变化，并论证生物之间存在共同祖先。华莱士也独立提出了相近的自然选择思想。
background.en: Darwin published On the Origin of Species in 1859, arguing that natural selection helps explain change over generations and common descent. Wallace independently developed a similar idea of natural selection.
